etymology.historical_story: The packet does not establish the historical origin of the surname Darrow. A documented cultural association is Clarence Darrow, an American lawyer whose career stretched across major social conflicts. He became a lawyer in 1879 and was still defending clients in 1936. His biography supplies context for the name, not proof of its linguistic ancestry. [Source: University of Minnesota Law Library](https://librarycollections.law.umn.edu/darrow/darrow_biography.php)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Darrow 的两拍读音联想成“达—柔”，再想象传记封面上的律师姓名；中文联想仅帮助记音，不解释姓氏来源。
